parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The accelerated domain name. You can specify only one domain name.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The sorting order. Valid values:

*   **traf**: by network traffic
*   **pv**: by the number of visits

Default value: **pv**.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

To query the data on a specified day, use the yyyy-MM-ddT16:00:00Z format.

If you do not set this parameter, data collected within the last 24 hours is queried.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-domain-top-refer-visit --domain-name example.com --start-time 2018-10-03T16:00:00Z --sort-by pv --region cn-hangzhou
